resources.string: Security Notice: Authorized clients route internet traffic through your connection and exit from your public IP address. Share access only with people you trust.
Your encrypted traffic is forwarded through the Host\'s internet egress. Sensitive credentials remain protected end-to-end over HTTPS, and your tunnel key rotates per session.
Traffic counters are measured locally at the tunnel interface and may differ slightly from the remote peer due to encryption and packet framing overhead.
